parameters.query: SELECT t.id, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', e.id, 'status', e.status, 'division_id', e.division_id, 'division', d.name, 'division_order', d.sort_order, 'squad_min', d.squad_min, 'squad_max', d.squad_max,   'team_code', tm.code, 'team_name', tm.name, 'team_short', tm.short_name, 'logo_key', tm.logo_key,   'payment_method', e.payment_method, 'amount', e.amount, 'utr', e.utr, 'proof_key', e.proof_key, 'reject_reason', e.reject_reason,   'registered_by', rb.name, 'registered_phone', rb.phone, 'created_at', DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'),   'squad', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('name', COALESCE(u.name, m.guest_name), 'photo_key', COALESCE(u.photo_key, m.guest_photo_key),      'age', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, COALESCE(u.birthdate, m.guest_birthdate), t.start_date), 'jersey_number', ep.jersey_number, 'is_guest', m.user_id IS NULL))    FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN team_members m ON m.id = ep.team_member_id LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id)))  FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = e.division_id  JOIN app_users rb ON rb.id = e.registered_by WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id) AS entries FROM tournaments t LEFT JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.code = $2 AND t.status <> 'DRAFT'
